twap_equals_spot.meaning: computed timeWeightedAverage is mathematically equal to current spot tradePrice

spot_price_manipulated.meaning: current spot tradePrice has been manipulated outside the allowed maxSlippage bound
spot_price_manipulated.checkpoint: Block N-1 spot price after attacker buy

price_within_slippage_bound.meaning: tradePrice is within previousPrice +/- maxSlippage% at the after-swap check

amount_out_min_zero.meaning: _performSwap sets amountOutMin = 0 for the V2 DEX swap

assumptions: buyBack is permissionless, so the attacker can call it at the chosen block.
The attacker can move the Uniswap V2 OLAS/secondToken spot price with a large OLAS buy in Block N-1.

unresolved.description: No numeric definition of maxSlippage, tradePrice, previousPrice, or the +/- relation is supplied, so the after-swap check's within-bound condition is encoded as a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric comparison.

limitations: imp_swap_receives_fewer_olas (fewer OLAS received) is a downstream economic consequence and is deferred to a future conservation/value-relation claim.
The exact arithmetic operators and tolerance handling of the after-swap check are not provided beyond the stated +/- maxSlippage% relation.
Whether real transactions occurred is conditional; the plan formalizes the reported safety relation symbolically.
